title: (Pwn2Own) Oracle Autonomous AI Database PL/SQL Gateway Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Oracle Autonomous AI Database. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
 
The specific flaw exists within the ORDS PL/SQL gateway. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
addtionnal_details:
Oracle has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cspunov2026.html
timeline:
2026-10-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor
2026-11-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory
2026-11-24  - Advisory Updated
